native_mechanisms: Try the two rows against each other at every possible single forward slip of one row (and with no slip at all) — i.e. enumerate all placements of exactly one gap
Walk the two rows house by house marking match vs mismatch one position at a time (a per-position Hamming-style comparison, one count per beat)
Reduce each trial to a single tally of mismatches and keep only the smallest tally across all trials, discarding the rest
core_technique: Full O(n^2) Needleman-Wunsch DP (with a scalar fallback for n<64), computed on anti-diagonal wavefronts with three rolling buffers and AVX2 32-bit SIMD max/blend — the standard aligner plus a generic wavefront-vectorisation optimisation, with no enumeration of single-gap shifts, no per-trial mismatch tally, and no minimum-over-trials selection.
